text:
Anna (CS): quick weekly check-in for PioneerAI — dedicated pool usage looked spiky overnight, jotting down the highlights so we can triage.
Mike (Ops): saw that too. overnight saturation hit ~92% on pool-6, queue depth spiked.
Jordan (SRE): confirmed, tail latency jumped around 03:10 UTC when queue_depth jumped to 78.
Anna (CS): metrics summary: GPU hours +15% WoW, spend +22% MoM, saturation peak 92%, avg queue depth 14 -> overnight 78, error rate up 0.3pp.
Liz (AM): renewal call next week — need to surface risk if costs keep rising. can we offer tuning before the call? :thinking_face: 
Mike (Ops): yes — immediate levers: temporary burst cap, tighter batching, enable prefix KV caching for their chat route. also consider scaling policy change from fixed to reactive for pool-6.
Jordan (SRE): adding notes from logs:
```
[03:08:41] pool-6: alloc_gpus=32 used=30 queued=78 wait_avg=12.4s
[03:10:03] model-serving: p50=42ms p95=310ms p99=1.1s
[03:12:00] retried requests due to runtime OOM on shard 7 (quantized variant)
```
Mike (Ops): OOMs likely from large-batch inference bursts + long sequences. PioneerAI started longer context tests last Friday.
Anna (CS): Pioneer mentioned in onboarding that they'd run nightly augmentation jobs — might be hitting reserved hours. Liz, can you confirm with them what changed?
Liz (AM): i pinged their eng lead — they switched to 8k context evaluation on Friday, will update in thread.
deploy-bot: deployment "pool-6-autoscale-policy-v2" scheduled at 2024-11-07T04:00:00Z :rocket: 
Jordan (SRE): suggested short-term mitigation: force fallback to q4-small variant for that tenant during midnight window, plus enable backpressure at router to cap inflight per-tenant.
Mike (Ops): estimated impact if we apply both: reduce peak saturation to ~68%, queue depth back to <10, token spend down ~18% for the window.
Anna (CS): action items: 1) Mike to rollout fallback policy to q4-small for PioneerAI (done?), 2) Jordan to add router backpressure rule for tenantID=pioneerai, 3) Liz to confirm customer-run augmentation and relay timing, 4) Anna to prepare a cost/opt report for renewal call.
Mike (Ops): starting rollout now — will report status in 10m.
Jordan (SRE): adding a short runbook entry to eng-runbooks titled "tenant spike -> fallback + backpressure".
Liz (AM): thx. if Pioneer prefers to avoid fallback, we can propose a reserved-hour top-up for the monthly commit and a short enablement session to tune batches.
Anna (CS): noted. that's a good seatbelt.
datadog-bot: metric snapshot for pool-6 (last 24h):
```
max_saturation: 92%
avg_saturation: 64%
median_queue_depth: 9
peak_queue_depth: 78
gpu_hours: 1,420h (+15% WoW)
error_rate: 0.82% (+0.3pp)
cost_estimate_MoM: $18.7k (+22%)
```
Mike (Ops): update — fallback applied, router backpressure rule in staging, monitoring alerts set for queue_depth>20 and p95>400ms.
Anna (CS): thanks team. Liz, once Pioneer confirms augmentation timing, we'll schedule the enablement sync and finalize recommendations for renewal pack.
Liz (AM): they replied: augmentation runs 02:45-04:15 UTC weekdays. asked if we can shift to 01:00-03:00. i'll negotiate.
Jordan (SRE): if they move earlier that helps. also will run a quick sim to see if shard 7 OOM recurs with smaller batches.
Anna (CS): i'll draft the cost/opt slide deck and include the recommended options: (A) reserved hours top-up, (B) autoscale + fallback rules, (C) model quantization + batch tuning session. sending draft by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Mike (Ops): will keep watch on alerts and report any regressions.
Anna (CS): closing here — next check-in monday unless something changes. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
